===Usage===
Copy and paste the following code to use the template.
<pre><nowiki>{{Top}}
{{Food
|image=
|name=
|origin=
|date=
|race=
|creator=
|found=
|type=
|description=
|animals=
|plants=
|other=
|edible=
|inedible=
|potable=
|nutrition=
|effects=
|dishes=
|affiliation=
}}</nowiki>
</pre>
===Parameters===
*{{Para|image}} &mdash; An image of the subject, if one exists
*{{Para|name}} &mdash; The title of the article
*{{Para|origin}} &mdash; The origin of the food/beverage, if known. Please note that a food/beverage only being present on a planet/moon/other location does not necessarily mean it ''originated'' from there and should be included in {{Para|found}} instead.
*{{Para|date}} &mdash; If a unique food/beverage was created on a certain date, that should be included. Please note that this field isn't intended for "By XYZ ABY" to indicate something common like wine existed by a very early point in galactic history; rather, this parameter is generally used for unique dishes that were created at some specifically defined point.
*{{Para|race}} &mdash; If a food/beverage is affiliated with a specific race, cultural group, or species it should be included here. 
*{{Para|creator}} &mdash; If a unique food/beverage has a creator, such as [[Strono Tuggs]] having created many dishes for his [[in-universe]] cookbooks, it should be included here. Note that for a generic topic such as [[wine]], a long list of creators is generally not included.
*{{Para|found}} &mdash; If a food/beverage is found on a planet&mdash;that is, it is available or otherwise established in-universe to have been findable at a location&mdash;it should be included here. Note that if a food ''originates'' from a location, that location should be included in {{Para|origin}} instead.
*{{Para|type}} &mdash; If a food/beverage has a type, it should be included here. For example, [[Cardekkia cheese]] is a type of [[cheese]] and [[Alderaanian wine]] is a type of [[wine]]. Wine itself, meanwhile, is a type of [[alcohol]]ic beverage.
*{{Para|description}} &mdash; Physical description of the food/beverage should be included, if details are known. Size, color(s), texture(s), taste (sweet/spicy, etc.) are some examples of physical descriptors.
*{{Para|animals}} &mdash; This field is for animal-based ingredients of the food/beverage. Animal-based ingredients might include meats, cheeses, dairy products, and eggs, among other animal products.
*{{Para|plants}} &mdash; This field is for plant-based ingredients of the food/beverage. Vegetables and fruits are good examples of plant-based ingredients, though many others may fall into this category.
*{{Para|other}} &mdash; This field is for any other ingredient of the food/beverage that is not plant or animal based.
*{{Para|edible}} &mdash; This field is for listing any species that can consume a food. Note that in rare circumstances, a {{Tl|C}} may be needed to establish that a species has only been confirmed to be able to consume something such as a fruit in juice form. Additionally, if something is a beverage, use {{Para|potable}} instead.
*{{Para|inedible}} &mdash; This field is for listing any species that cannot consume a food.
*{{Para|potable}} &mdash; This field is for listing any species that can consume a beverage. Note that {{Para|potable}} is used for food instead.
*{{Para|nutrition}} &mdash; If a food/beverage has specific nutritional information or data, it can be included here.
*{{Para|effects}} &mdash; If a food/beverage has specific physical effects on consumers of it, those can be included here. Examples might include if a beverage causes alcoholic intoxication, or a rare type of food that makes people hungrier or perhaps ill. Note that this field is not generally used to just say "it could make someone feel more full"&mdash;that is sort of a given effect of food.
*{{Para|dishes}} &mdash; This field is primarily used for food ingredients, such as a fruit that may be used in a dish. For example, [[jybbuk-fruit]] is an ingredient of [[Spiced Jybbuk Juice]], and [[chokeroot]] is an ingredient of [[mashed chokeroot]].
*{{Para|affiliation}} &mdash; This field is for listing the affiliation of a food/beverage. Please note that only having a food consumed at an establishment or it being available there does not necessarily constitute affiliation. For example, [[wine]] is not individually affiliated with the hundreds (if not thousands) of cantinas that serve it. However, specific dishes such as [[Fried Endorian Tip-Yip]], might be considered affiliated with the restauraunts its served in&mdash;[[Tuggs' Grub]] and [[Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo]]&mdash;given that the creator of the dish, [[Strono Tuggs]], specifically created it for his establishments. Or, for example, ''[[Tiingilar]]'', is established in-universe to be a traditional [[Mandalorian]] dish, meaning it would be advisable to consider it affiliated with Mandalorians.
